patterns.explanation: The letter a: uppercase A, lowercase a. Main sound /æ/; also /eɪ/ (a as in cake).
The letter b: uppercase B, lowercase b. Main sound /b/.
The letter c: uppercase C, lowercase c. Main sound /k/; also /s/ (c as in city).
The letter d: uppercase D, lowercase d. Main sound /d/.
The letter e: uppercase E, lowercase e. Main sound /ɛ/; also /iː/ (e as in me).
The letter f: uppercase F, lowercase f. Main sound /f/.
The letter g: uppercase G, lowercase g. Main sound /ɡ/; also /dʒ/ (g as in giraffe).
The letter h: uppercase H, lowercase h. Main sound /h/.
The letter i: uppercase I, lowercase i. Main sound /ɪ/; also /aɪ/ (i as in kite).
The letter j: uppercase J, lowercase j. Main sound /dʒ/.
The letter k: uppercase K, lowercase k. Main sound /k/.
The letter l: uppercase L, lowercase l. Main sound /l/.
The letter m: uppercase M, lowercase m. Main sound /m/.
The letter n: uppercase N, lowercase n. Main sound /n/.
The letter o: uppercase O, lowercase o. Main sound /ɑ/; also /oʊ/ (o as in go).
The letter p: uppercase P, lowercase p. Main sound /p/.
The letter q: uppercase Q, lowercase q. Main sound /kw/.
The letter r: uppercase R, lowercase r. Main sound /ɹ/.
The letter s: uppercase S, lowercase s. Main sound /s/; also /z/ (s as in is).
The letter t: uppercase T, lowercase t. Main sound /t/.
The letter u: uppercase U, lowercase u. Main sound /ʌ/; also /juː/ (u as in unicorn).
The letter v: uppercase V, lowercase v. Main sound /v/.
The letter w: uppercase W, lowercase w. Main sound /w/.
The letter x: uppercase X, lowercase x. Main sound /ks/.
The letter y: uppercase Y, lowercase y. Main sound /j/; also /aɪ/ (y as in my), /i/ (y as in happy).
The letter z: uppercase Z, lowercase z. Main sound /z/.
